summary: This file is a MMDetection3D-style configuration file (no callable functions, classes, or methods). It defines hyperparameters and pipeline settings for a NeRF-based 3D object detection model (nerfdet) using a ResNet-50 backbone on the ScanNet dataset with 18 indoor object classes.
config_description: Configures a nerfdet model with ResNet-50 backbone, FPN neck, FastIndoorImVoxelNeck 3D neck, and ScanNetImVoxelHeadV2 bounding box head. Uses image + depth + ray inputs for 3D detection on ScanNet with 18 classes. Training uses AdamW optimizer, 12 epochs with step LR decay at epochs 8 and 11, and a RepeatDataset multiplier of 6.
key_config_sections: model: nerfdet architecture with ResNet-50 backbone, FPN, voxel neck, and bounding box head (18 classes, 40x40x16 voxels)
input_modality: enables image, depth, and ray inputs; disables lidar and neural reconstruction depth
train_pipeline/test_pipeline: MultiViewPipeline with 50/101 images, 320x240 resolution, random loading, and NEF target views
data: ScanNetMultiViewDataset with train/val/test splits, RepeatDataset (6x) for training, Depth box type
training: AdamW (lr=0.0002), 12 total epochs, step LR at [8,11], gradient clipping (max_norm=35), NCCL distributed training
note: This is a configuration-only file with no functions, classes, or importable APIs. It is consumed by the MMDetection3D framework at runtime via config loading.
